summary: Target solve time budget (seconds); the solver may exceed it to find any solution.
range: Integer seconds. >= 300–420s recommended for large inputs.
businessRules: Soft target — solver can run longer to return a feasible solution for large problems.

solving_time_limit defines: Specify the number of seconds within which the optimizer should ideally solve the optimization request. Please note that: * In case the specified time limit is not enough to generate a solution for…
Values in seconds; must be non-negative. Zero means instantaneous.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Boundary: very small limit may yield a lower-quality but valid solution.
